decisions.reason: The online portal is distant from the core display business and its brief website mention suggests results are still uncertain and may be below aspiration, but the firm's hiring and investing slack lets management carry it for now.
The packaging display solution won the 2024 German Packaging Award, signalling performance above the firm's own and comparable aspirations and making a drop very unlikely.
As a close-to-core quarter-pallet pegboard display with its own product page, it likely meets the firm's established benchmarks and can be carried with minimal risk.
The small counter display is close to the firm's established offer and has a dedicated page, indicating results in line with aspirations and little pressure to drop it.
The large freestanding information display is a core-related product with dedicated presentation, so it meets performance expectations and is very likely to be kept.
